item.title: Middle East live: Netanyahu held 'secret' meeting in UAE with president, Israeli PM's office says
item.description: Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu held a "secret" meeting with the president of the United Arab Emirates, Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, during its war with Iran, the premier's office revealed on Wednesday. Earlier, US President Donald ⁠Trump said he expected to have a "long talk" about the Iran war with his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping when they meet for a high-stakes summit in Beijing. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

item.title: At Cannes 2026, Gaza Becomes a Political Flashpoint
item.description: The event’s leaders immediately jumped into the debate over whether festival participants should speak out on issues like Israel and Gaza.

item.title: Trump shuts down Iran's response to US peace proposal
item.description: Iran, which on Sunday sent its response to the latest US ceasefire proposal, wants negotiations to focus on permanently ending the war. However, US President Donald Trump quickly rejected it as “totally unacceptable”. He did not explain why. Iran seeks to end the war on all fronts, including in Lebanon, where Israel is fighting the Iranian-backed Hezbollah militant group, and to ensure the security of shipping. Follow our blog to see how the day's events unfolded.

item.title: Independent Israeli report accuses Hamas of 'systematic' sexual violence during October 7 attacks
item.description: A new independent commission finds Hamas and its allies committed "systematic, widespread" sexual violence during their October 7, 2023 attack on Israel and against hostages they took back to Gaza. This comes as the Knesset passed a law establishing a special military tribunal to try Palestinian militants accused of taking part in the October 7 attacks, under which the death penalty could be handed down. FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky tells us more form Jerusalem.

item.title: Iran warns US to accept peace plan or risk collapse of Mideast truce
item.description: Iran’s chief negotiator said on Tuesday that Washington must accept Tehran’s latest peace plan or risk the collapse of the Middle East truce, after President Donald Trump warned the ceasefire was near failure. The war, triggered by US-Israeli strikes on Iran more than two months ago, has destabilised the region and rattled global markets.

item.title: Some Iranians fear the regime is now more entrenched - and ready for revenge
item.description: Ordinary Iranians tell of worry about increased repression by authorities after the war is over.

item.title: Romanians fearful as Danube Delta targeted by Russian attacks
item.description: Several heads of state, including Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, are gathering in Bucharest this Wednesday for the B9 summit, which brings together NATO's eastern flank countries amid growing tensions linked to the war in Ukraine. Even in Romania, the conflict feels increasingly present. In recent months, Russian attacks have intensified against Ukrainian Danube ports located just a few hundred metres from the Romanian border.

item.title: Perfect Timing, Big Payouts: Insider Trading Red Flags Emerge on Polymarket
item.description: Dozens of long-shot bets on Polymarket, from the war with Iran to the cryptocurrency market, have defied the odds, according to a New York Times examination.
